explanation: Job 2's output fails to preserve upstream provenance order in priorities: every priority has upstream_rank 0 even though the Job 2 input evidence_sources contains ranks 1 through 8. The supplied downstream code localizes this to prioritize(), which builds rank_by_record_id from evidence_sources.record_id values, but those identities are source ids (s01, s02, etc.) while coverage records use need record ids (n06-r01, n06-r02, etc.), so no ranks match and all priorities default to 0.
cited_evidence: Job 2 input evidence_sources includes ranked provenance records with record_id/source_id s01..s08 and rank 1..8.
Observed Job 2 priorities set upstream_rank to 0 for all records n06-r01 through n06-r08.

downstream_coverage_priority.py prioritize(): rank_by_record_id[evidence.get("record_id", "")] = evidence.get("rank", 0), then upstream_rank uses rank_by_record_id.get(coverage.get("record_id", ""), 0).
Coverage records use need record_id values such as n06-r01, while evidence_sources record_id values are source provenance identities such as s01.
